extras: Warning: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Preview and repair broken image embeds in the active note or every Markdown note in a selected folder, using unique filename matches from a selected attachment folder.
problem: Image links often break when Markdown notes are moved or copied into an Obsidian vault because the original file paths become invalid.
summary: Image Relinker scans Markdown notes and attachment folders to safely preview and repair broken image links by matching unique filenames.
